01 / THE MISSION

ONE IDEA.
REAL POTENTIAL.

Startush Smackdown is Elevate 3.0’s Business Pitching Competition. Bring a business idea into focus, make its value clear, and give people a reason to believe in it.

02 / GET A HEAD START

PREPARE TO PITCH.

A little preparation goes a long way.
Here’s where you can begin.

01

Know your problem.

Understand the people you want to help. Make the need clear, specific, and worth solving.

02

Shape the business.

Explain your solution, the opportunity, and how your idea can create lasting value.

03

Own your pitch.

Build a clear story around your idea. Be ready to explain your thinking and make your case.

These are preparation suggestions. Official rules, requirements, and judging criteria will be announced separately.

What is Startush Smackdown?+

Startush Smackdown is the Business Pitching Competition at Elevate 3.0, where participants develop and present their business ideas.

The permitted idea stages, eligibility criteria, and team rules will be confirmed in the official participation guidelines.

How long is the pitch, and what will judges look for?+

Pitch duration, deck requirements, judging criteria, and the competition format are being finalized. Confirmed details will be published here.

When does registration open?+

The registration date, entry requirements, and sign-up link will be announced here. No applications are being collected yet.
